title: [FEAT] Fast API Middleware in Routers
body:
### First Check

- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI,APIRouter
from extension import RouterExtension, AppExtension

app = FastAPI()
router = APIRouter()

@app.get("/")
async def app_route():
    #Some route

@app.get("/")
async def router_route():
    #Some route

router.add_extension(RouterExtension())
app.include_router(router, "/router")

#### Extension
from fastapi import Extension

class CustomExtension(Extension):
      def before_request(self, req):
          pass

      def after_request(self, resp):
          pass

      # Other methods for extensions
```


### Description

I want to be able to create an extension for Fast API so I don't need to write the same stuff on multiple routes (like accessing a database or authenticating a user). This could then help to speed up certain areas of development by having a single extension for it

### Operating System

Other

### Operating System Details

Should be able to work on any OS

### FastAPI Version

0.115.0

### Pydantic Version

2.10.1

### Python Version

3.13

### Additional Context

This is a feature request
